title: Ловушка для Никиты  (A Trap for Nikita)

segments.t: Mikhail Jekovich reminds Barinov how hard he has worked to earn a Michelin star. Meanwhile, Nikita realizes that the thugs he tipped off are planning to kill Denis rather than just rough him up—and when Nikita threatens to call the police, the thugs kidnap him too!
Мы с тобой сколько инспекций прошли!
Я думал, вы его просто побьёте.
Мы с вами так не договаривались.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Misha, well, this is somehow wrong.' In Russian, the idea of 'Misha' flows naturally into 'wrongly' without extra filler words.
'You deserved this star, after all!' The grammar packs 'you' and 'earned' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Мы с тобой сколько инспекций прошли!
'How many inspections you and I have been through!' In Russian, the idea of 'we' flows naturally into 'to go through' without extra filler words.
'We cannot lose all of this right now.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'one must not' before landing on 'to lose'.
'Wait, he will suffocate like that!' Nikita brings out the contrast between 'wait' and 'he' in a few short words.
Я думал, вы его просто побьёте.
'I thought you would just beat him up.' Nikita chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'you will beat up' to keep a polite distance.
'And you are planning to kill him!' Nikita chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'to intend' to keep a polite distance.
Мы с вами так не договаривались.
'We did not agree on that.' Nikita chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'agree' to keep a polite distance. Mikhail answers right away.
'We did not make any agreement with you at all.' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'agree' covers a group or the polite 'you'.
'You came here yourself, after all.' Mikhail addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'arrived'.
'Stop, you cannot do that at all!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'stop' and finishing on 'one must not'.

'I will report this to the police right now!' Nikita anchors the line on 'I', while 'I will report' completes the thought. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Мы с тобой сколько инспекций прошли!
Я думал, вы его просто побьёте.
Мы с вами так не договаривались.
Now both rivals for Katya's heart find themselves tied up side by side in a dark basement. See you next time!
